scope: Existing sender-boundary states only, no TCP or optimization. Common3MB/s is an arbitrary shared unit, not trace capacity or a policy input. Recomputes the same logged endpoint-density approximation with common scale; does not reconstruct interval internal congestion or prove retraining would improve. Boundary-selected trim10 is distinct from exact packet-log network trim10. Reward ranking across endogenous per-run observed peaks is not a common network-performance yardstick.
